Downloading alien species occurrences for Belgium from [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org)

Script based on the [TrIAS species cube workflow provided by Oldoni et al.](https://github.com/trias-project/occ-cube/tree/master)

```{r clear-memory}
rm(list=ls())
```

# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Kies de radius versie: "origineel" (2024) of "2026_10"
radius_version <- "2026_10"

# Kies "GBIF" of "COL": op basis van welke taxonomische key wordt de download uitgevoerd
taxonomy <- "COL"

stopifnot(taxonomy %in% c("GBIF", "COL"))

code_column <- switch(
  taxonomy,
  GBIF = "GBIF_code",
  COL = "COL_code"
)

checklist_key <- switch(
  taxonomy,
  GBIF = "d7dddbf4-2cf0-4f39-9b2a-bb099caae36c",
  COL = "7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b"
)
```

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)      
library(here)          
library(rgbif)        
library(trias)         
library(lubridate)     
library(sf)
library(vecsets)
```

```{r import-species-list}
species_list <- read_csv(
  here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version, "radius_species_list.csv"),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)

taxonKeys <- unique(species_list[[code_column]])

# Koppeling tussen speciesKey in de download en de gekozen codekolom
species_join <- setNames(code_column, "speciesKey")
```

# Define download query parameters

## Taxa

Selecteer de codes op basis van de gekozen taxonomie.

```{r define-taxa}
taxonKeys <- species_list %>%
  pull(all_of(code_column)) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

stopifnot(!anyNA(taxonKeys), all(nzchar(taxonKeys)))
```

## Countries

```{r define-countries}
countries <- c("BE")
```

## Basis of record

```{r define-basis-of-record}
basis_of_record <- c(
  "OBSERVATION",
  "HUMAN_OBSERVATION",
  "MATERIAL_SAMPLE",
  "LITERATURE",
  "PRESERVED_SPECIMEN",
  "UNKNOWN",
  "MACHINE_OBSERVATION"
)
```

## Year

```{r define-year}
year_begin <- 2015
year_end <- year(Sys.Date())
```

## Geographic coordinates

```{r define-hasCoordinates}
hasCoordinate <- TRUE
```

# Download GBIF occurrences

## Trigger download

Voer deze chunk handmatig uit om een nieuwe download aan te vragen. De gekozen taxonomie wordt gebruikt voor zowel de selectie als de uitvoer. De downloadcode wordt per taxonomie opgeslagen.

```{r gbif-download, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE}
gbif_downloadKey <- occ_download(
  pred_in("taxonKey", taxonKeys, checklistKey = checklist_key),
  pred_in("country", countries),
  pred_in("basisOfRecord", basis_of_record),
  pred_gte("year", year_begin),
  pred_lte("year", year_end),
  pred("hasCoordinate", hasCoordinate),
  checklistKey = checklist_key,
  format = "DWCA",
  user = rstudioapi::askForPassword("GBIF username"),
  pwd = rstudioapi::askForPassword("GBIF password"),
  email = rstudioapi::askForPassword("Email address for notification")
)

writeLines(
  as.character(gbif_downloadKey),
  here(
    "radius", "data", "input", radius_version,
    paste0("gbif_download_key_", tolower(taxonomy), ".txt")
  )
)

occ_download_wait(
  gbif_downloadKey,
  curlopts = list(
    verbose = TRUE,
    http_version = 2,
    forbid_reuse = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Reuse download

Lees de opgeslagen downloadcode voor de gekozen versie en taxonomie.
Bij de eerste uitvoering moet eerst de aanvraag hierboven zijn uitgevoerd.

```{r reuse-download}
gbif_downloadKey <- readLines(
  here(
    "radius", "data", "input", radius_version,
    paste0("gbif_download_key_", tolower(taxonomy), ".txt")
  )
)
```

## Download ophalen

```{r gbif-dataset-to-computer}
gbif_download <- occ_download_get(
  key = gbif_downloadKey,
  path = here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version),
  overwrite = FALSE
)
```

## Waarnemingen inlezen

```{r gbif-dataset-to-R}
occ_raw <- occ_download_import(gbif_download) %>%
  mutate(
    speciesKey = as.character(speciesKey),
    taxonKey = as.character(taxonKey)
  )
```

# Filter data

## Define filters on occurrences
```{r define-issues-to-discard}
issues_to_discard <- c(
  "ZERO_COORDINATE",
  "COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE", 
  "COORDINATE_INVALID",
  "COUNTRY_COORDINATE_MISMATCH"
)
```

```{r define-occurrenceStatus-to-discard}
occurrenceStatus_to_discard <- c(
  "ABSENT")
```

```{r define-identificationVerificationStatus-to-discard}
identificationVerificationStatus_to_discard <- c(
  "unverified",
  "not validated", 
  "under validation"
)
```

## Filter occurrences

```{r filter-occurrence-data}
occ_filtered <- occ_raw %>%
  # Bij ontbrekende occurrenceID de unieke GBIF identificator gebruiken.
  mutate(
    record_id = if_else(
      is.na(occurrenceID) | str_trim(occurrenceID) == "",
      paste0("gbif:", gbifID),
      paste0("occ:", occurrenceID)
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(record_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-record_id) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(decimalLongitude),
    !is.na(decimalLatitude),
    !occurrenceStatus %in% occurrenceStatus_to_discard,

    # Ook uitsluiten wanneer meerdere foutcodes samen voorkomen.
    !str_detect(
      coalesce(issue, ""),
      paste(issues_to_discard, collapse = "|")
    ),

    !identificationVerificationStatus %in%
      identificationVerificationStatus_to_discard,

    # Onzekerheid maximaal 100 m; ontbrekende waarden blijven behouden.
    coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 100 |
      is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters),

    # Eerder geïdentificeerde foutieve waarneming van schijnambrosia.
    gbifID != 4430037392
  )
```

## Filter occurrences for Flanders

```{r make-spatial}
occ_spatial <- st_as_sf(occ_filtered, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
                 crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")
```

```{r map-flanders}
Vlaanderen_grenzen <- st_read(here("prius", "data", "spatial", "flanders_wgs84.geojson"))
```

```{r filter-occ-flanders}
occ_flanders_spatial <- st_transform(
  occ_spatial,
  crs = st_crs(Vlaanderen_grenzen)
) %>%
  st_join(Vlaanderen_grenzen) %>%
  filter(!is.na(UIDN))

occ_flanders <- occ_flanders_spatial %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    decimalLongitude = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    decimalLatitude = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
```

# Summarise output

## Map taxa to species
Grouping by `speciesKey`, we lose information about which taxa share the same `speciesKey`. This information could be sometimes helpful. We extract it in a separate data.frame, `taxa_species`.

```{r get-distinct-taxa-in-occ-flanders}
occ_flanders_taxa <- occ_flanders %>%
  select(speciesKey, taxonKey, scientificName) %>%
  distinct()
```

Some species have occurrences coming from multiple taxa, synonyms and/or infraspecific taxa:
```{r show-multiple-taxonKey}
occ_flanders_taxa %>%
  group_by(speciesKey) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  left_join(occ_flanders_taxa, by = "speciesKey") %>%
  arrange(speciesKey, taxonKey) %>%
  pull(taxonKey) -> List_multiple_taxonKeys
```

Some species have occurrences only from taxa linked to their infraspecific taxa or synonyms. In these cases `speciesKey` is never equal to `taxonKey`:
```{r show_taxa_speciesKey_not_taxonKey}
occ_flanders_taxa %>%
  group_by(speciesKey) %>%
  count() %>%
  rename(n_taxa = n) %>%
  left_join(occ_flanders_taxa, by = "speciesKey") %>%
  group_by(speciesKey, n_taxa) %>%
  filter(taxonKey != speciesKey) %>%
  count() %>%
  rename(n_taxonKey_not_speciesKey = n) %>%
  filter(n_taxonKey_not_speciesKey == n_taxa) %>%
  left_join(occ_flanders_taxa %>%
              filter(speciesKey != taxonKey),
            by = "speciesKey") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c(n_taxa, n_taxonKey_not_speciesKey)) %>%
  arrange(speciesKey, taxonKey)
```

We bewaren per soort welke taxa in de waarnemingen voorkomen. De soortnaam
en het rijk worden overgenomen uit de download en volgen de gekozen taxonomie.

```{r make_taxa_species}
species_info <- occ_flanders %>%
  filter(!is.na(speciesKey)) %>%
  distinct(speciesKey, species, kingdom) %>%
  rename(scientificName = species)

taxa_species <- occ_flanders_taxa %>%
  filter(!is.na(speciesKey)) %>%
  group_by(speciesKey) %>%
  summarise(
    includes = paste(
      taxonKey,
      scientificName,
      sep = ": ",
      collapse = " | "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(species_info, by = "speciesKey") %>%
  mutate(rank = "SPECIES") %>%
  select(speciesKey, scientificName, rank, kingdom, includes)
```

## Comparison radius_species_list and gbif occurrences

```{r subset-columns}
occ_flanders <- occ_flanders %>%
  left_join(species_list, by = species_join) %>%
  transmute(
    year, month, day,
    decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude,
    speciesKey, Species, Soort,
    coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, month, day, speciesKey)
```

```{r comparison-species-list-gbif-occurrences}
occ_flanders_summary <- occ_flanders %>%
  group_by(speciesKey, Soort) %>%
  summarise(n_obs = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Koppelen via de gekozen taxonomische code.
species_summary <- species_list %>%
  left_join(
    occ_flanders_summary,
    by = c(setNames("speciesKey", code_column), "Soort")
  )

not_in_flanders <- species_summary %>%
  filter(is.na(n_obs)) %>%
  filter(!.data[[code_column]] %in% List_multiple_taxonKeys) %>%
  select(Groep, Species, Soort, GBIF_code, any_of("COL_code"))

in_flanders <- species_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_obs)) %>%
  select(Groep, Species, Soort, GBIF_code, any_of("COL_code"), n_obs) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_obs))

List_species_present <- unique(in_flanders$Soort)
List_species_not_present <- vsetdiff(
  unique(species_list$Soort),
  List_species_present
)

write_csv(
  in_flanders,
  here("radius", "data", "intermediate", radius_version, "species_in_flanders.csv")
)

write_csv(
  not_in_flanders,
  here("radius", "data", "intermediate", radius_version, "species_not_in_flanders.csv")
)
```

## Remove absent species from species list
```{r}
species_list <- species_list %>%
  filter(Soort %in% in_flanders$Soort)

write_csv(species_list, here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version, "radius_species_list.csv"))
```


## Save occurrence dataset flanders

```{r save-occurrence-dataset}
write_csv(occ_flanders, here("radius", "data", "input", radius_version, "gbif_occ_flanders.csv"))
```
